messages:
alex: P1 page - ELB 502/504 spike observed from us-west-2 (AZd) at ~09:07 UTC. Error rate ~12% on production frontends, synthetic checks failing. Seeing TCP RSTs to egress proxies. Investigating now. :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2712 created. Severity: P1. Paging oncall: @karen (primary), @jason (network). Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/incidents/egress-path

oncall-bot: oncall handoff requested. Current oncall: karen. If no ack in 2m, escalate to sofie.

karen: ack - taking this. quick summary? where are errors coming from (ELB vs instances)?

alex: ELB frontends return 502/504. Backend instance metrics look OK for CPU/mem, but AWSVPC egress logs have connection resets and a handful of ENI tx drops. ELB logs show upstream reset as cause. curl from a host in AZd to an external dependency returns 502/Bad Gateway.

jason: checking Route53/weighting, nothing changed recently. I'm seeing a sudden increase in egress rewrite rules on the NAT host pool - config pushed ~09:05 UTC by deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-15T09:04:56Z: autoscaling-group/azd-egress-proxies config v2.14 applied by infra-deploy pipeline. No downtime expected.

maria: customers report increased 502s for inference endpoints (region: us-west-2). I opened a support ticket for the top paying customer, priority high. Preparing status page blurb.

sofie: from a quick tcpdump on one nat host: seeing source IPs rewritten to unexpected SNAT range, then peers reply to a different MAC -> asymmetric flow -> upstream reset. Suspect iptables nat-prerouting chain rewrite was applied incorrectly.

alex: copying tcpdump snippet:
```
IP 10.0.3.45.443 > 198.51.100.12.52024: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0, length 0
10.0.3.45 -> 198.51.100.12: TCP_RST
```

jason: action plan suggestion: 1) take AZd egress proxies out of ELB target groups (drain) 2) revert latest egress-proxy config in pipeline 3) set Route53 weights to shift traffic away from AZd while we validate. I'll start 1 & 3 unless objections.

karen: +1 on plan. Prioritize traffic shift first to reduce customer impact. Keep changes small and reversible.

jason: running command to set Route53 weight to redirect AZd to 5% then 0% if stable:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2-azd","Weight":0,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"54.1.2.3"}]}}]}'
```

jason: changed weight for us-west-2 AZd -> 0 (propagation ongoing). Confirmed decrease in requests hitting AZd within ~60s.

maria: updating status: "We are mitigating an ELB/egress issue in us-west-2 impacting a subset of customers. Traffic is being shifted away from the affected AZ; more details to follow." :pencil2:

karen: next step: revert egress-proxy config. jason, can you coordinate a rollback with infra-deploy? Keep one healthy proxy as probe if possible.

jason: initiating rollback to v2.13 on the egress-proxy ASG. Command: `infra-deploy rollback autoscaling-group azd-egress-proxies --to v2.13`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for autoscaling-group/azd-egress-proxies -> target version v2.13. Rolling updates: maxUnavailable=1, grace=30s.

sofie: as rollback rolls, tcpdumps show RSTs decreasing on replaced proxies. ELB 5xx rate dropping to ~1.5% now.

alex: monitoring dashboards: 5xx moving toward baseline. Synthetic checks passing in us-west-2 after weight shift and rollback. Looks like the config change introduced an incorrect SNAT mapping.

karen: good. keep Route53 weight at 0 for AZd until we've validated a 10-minute stable window. Start a post-incident RCA draft (assign to jason + sofie) and include the deploy pipeline guardrails we need.

jason: capturing timeline and artifacts. Will include deploy diff, iptables rules that caused rewrite, and who approved the change in pipeline.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2712 status: mitigated -> partial. Next steps: validation window 10m, RCA owners: jason, sofie.

maria: Customer comms: posted preliminary status to status.redwood.ai: "Mitigated - traffic shifted away from affected AZ; rolling rollback applied. Some customers may have seen increased errors between 09:05-09:18 UTC." Will set follow-up note when RCA ready.

karen: handoff to followup oncall @sofie for deep dive and RCA. I'm going offline for rotation change in 10m. sofie, you have the lead. :thumbsup:

sofie: taking lead for RCA and postmortem. I'll run a full inventory of NAT host rules and lock the deploy pipeline change that allowed the bad rewrite without canary.

alex: final check: any other regions showing similar symptoms? Negative - this looks isolated to us-west-2 AZd egress pool.

jason: I'll keep Route53 weight at 0 and schedule a controlled canary for v2.14 after we implement a validation test and pipeline approval gate.

karen: closing incident channel in 30m if no regressions. Great job team. :heart:

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. autoscaling-group/azd-egress-proxies -> v2.13. health checks OK.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2712 moved to status: monitoring. Root cause: incorrect SNAT rewrite rule introduced in egress-proxy config v2.14 -> asymmetric flows -> upstream resets -> ELB 5xx spike. RCA owners assigned.

sofie: adding quick mitigation notes to runbook: - add canary deploy to egress-proxy pipeline - add automated validation for SNAT rules - alert when ENI tx drops > threshold in 1m window.

maria: final status update posted to customers - will send follow-up email with timeline and mitigation once RCA complete.

alex: thanks everyone. incident thread will remain archived under INC-2712.
